title: UK gambling regulator weighs allowing crypto payments for online betting
summary: Any rollout would still require strict affordability and suitability checks, and crypto activity would need FCA authorization, Gambling Commission executive Tim Miller said.

title: Pantera, Franklin Templeton join Sentient Arena to test AI agents
summary: Sentient launched Arena, a production-style platform to test AI agents on enterprise tasks, with Pantera and Franklin Templeton joining the initial cohort.

title: New York judge blocks Binance bid to force US crypto claims into arbitration
summary: The ruling keeps pre‑2019 investor claims in open court and rejects Binance’s bid to send the dispute to private arbitration in Singapore.

title: Bitcoin’s five-month losing streak may not end in March as $70K caps price
summary: Bitcoin bulls were battling to flip three resistance levels back into support by the end of the week, but history shows they may need to wait another month.

title: Suspected insider wallets rack up $1.2M betting on ZachXBT’s Axiom exposé
summary: The top eight wallets on Polymarket netted over $1.2 million by betting on ZachXBT’s investigation into Axiom, raising insider trading concerns among blockchain researchers.

title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs take in $1B in three days as investors buy the dip
summary: SoSoValue data shows a three-day reversal after weeks of withdrawals, with BlackRock’s IBIT leading inflows.

title: TeraWulf misses Q4 2025 estimates as Bitcoin mining revenue falls
summary: TeraWulf’s Q4 losses hit $1.66 per share as mining revenue fell, but AI and high-performance computing contracts worth $12.8 billion set up potential 2026 growth.

title: Bitcoin miner MARA posts $1.7B quarterly loss on BTC slump
summary: MARA reported a $1.71 billion quarterly loss as Bitcoin fair‑value markdowns hit earnings and the company laid out a major push into AI and high‑performance compute.

title: XRPL Foundation patches ‘critical’ flaw that almost made it to mainnet
summary: The AI bug hunter scanned the Ripple blockchain codebase to catch the vulnerability before it was deployed, enabling engineers to patch it.

title: Australian crypto execs upbeat on progress despite lingering issues
summary: Self-managed super funds are becoming a vehicle for Australians to invest in digital assets as traders search for ways to diversify their holdings.
